- **Bring your photos over from other apps (Beta):** Frameleaf Manager can now import from PhotoPrism, Photoview, PiGallery2, Lychee, Nextcloud, Piwigo and LibrePhotos running on the same server, and from an Ente Photos export folder. It shows who owns what and anything that can't come over before you start.
- **Pausing really pauses:** pausing a job in the Jobs page now also holds library scans, Library Care, descriptions and tags, and cloud smart search and face work, and they pick up where they left off when you resume.
- **Gentler on big libraries:** working out each photo's colours no longer reads every original off your drive, and the Activity page no longer keeps the database busy while it's open.
- **Database sized for your server:** Frameleaf Manager now gives the library database memory to match how much your server has, so large libraries stay quick.
- **Clearer logs:** the server and Manager logs now say what they're using at startup and show one tidy line per request, for when you need to troubleshoot.
- **Fixes:** a round of smaller fixes from our latest review.
